國際關懷協會（Care Ministries International, CM: Care Ministries International (CMI) was founded by Pastor 李秀全. It first registered with the Hong Kong government in 1997 under the name Care Society, then formally established operations in the United States in 2001. It is an interdenominational Chinese-speaking faith mission agency focused on cross-cultural missions.
「福音進中華‧福音出中華」為協會異象，透過進中華的事奉，邁向出中華的目標，藉由全: “The gospel to China; the gospel from China” is CMI’s vision. Through ministry into China, we move toward sending the gospel out from China. Through full-time and professional service, based on the whole Bible, we mobilize the whole church to bring the whole gospel to the whole world.
關懷，表達了基督對我們的愛；關懷，也表達了我們對中華的愛。關懷一詞的英文是CAR: Care expresses Christ’s love for us and our love for China. The four letters of CARE convey CMI’s ministry priorities:
C：CHRIST CENTEREDNESS以基督為中心。: C: CHRIST CENTEREDNESS — Christ at the centre.
A：ATONEMENT 以救贖為道路。: A: ATONEMENT — redemption as the way.
R：RECONCILIATION以和好為宗旨。: R: RECONCILIATION — reconciliation as the purpose.
E：EVANGELIZATION以宣教為使命。: E: EVANGELIZATION — missions as the calling.
根據工場的需要，差派長期宣教士以及專業、帶職、短期、特約的宣教士從事慈惠、醫療、: In response to the needs of the field, CMI sends long-term, professional, tentmaking, short-term, and associate missionaries to serve through compassion, medical care, education, evangelism, and training, bearing witness to the gospel and nurturing communities of Christ’s disciples.
差會成立迄今，已有來自臺灣、美國、加拿大、紐西蘭與創啟地區的宣教士們，分別在泰國: Since its founding, CMI has sent missionaries from Taiwan, the United States, Canada, New Zealand, and restricted-access regions to serve cross-culturally in Thailand, Cambodia, and restricted-access fields. It also supports gospel work among ethnic minority groups in Myanmar. In recent years, it has actively explored ministry in Japan and other countries.
目前在美國、臺灣、紐西蘭、澳洲、加拿大、日本及創啟地區已分別成立CMI地區辦公室: CMI has established regional offices in the United States, Taiwan, New Zealand, Australia, Canada, Japan, and restricted-access regions. These serve as bases for recruiting, training, and sending missionaries.
宣教動員：在各地動員、裝備並徵召門徒成為宣教士，前往工場，透過不同途徑，開荒、佈: Mission mobilization: mobilizing, equipping, and calling disciples to become missionaries. Through different approaches, they pioneer ministries, share the gospel, establish churches, and train disciples of Jesus Christ in the field to fulfil the Great Commission.
宣教祈禱：以「宣教毋忘祈禱、祈禱毋忘宣教」（mission and prayer: Mission prayer: guided by “missions and prayer” and “prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer,” CMI calls partners to pray for missions, establishes monthly prayer fellowships, and holds annual mission prayer conferences in the western and southeastern United States and Taiwan.
宣教關顧：成立宣教關顧團契，推動全程（由徵召到退休）的關顧觀念及作法。: Missionary care: establishing missionary care fellowships and encouraging care throughout a missionary’s service, from recruitment to retirement.
宣教教育：透過與神學院的合作，在宣教工場進行為期六至八週的暑期跨文化宣教實習與訓: Mission education: in partnership with seminaries, CMI offers six-to-eight-week summer Mission Field Training (MFT), emphasizing cross-cultural practice and training in the field. Partners have included Logos Evangelical Seminary in the United States and Taiwan’s China Evangelical Seminary, Lutheran Theological Seminary, Disciple Training Theological Seminary, Central Taiwan Theological Seminary, Holy Light Theological Seminary, Truth Theological Seminary, Alliance Theological Seminary, Baptist Theological Seminary, and a seminary in a restricted-access region. A hundred participants have completed MFT, with numbers increasing each year. Several now serve in mission fields; others have returned home after two years of short-term service.
醫療宣教（medical outreach）：透過醫謢人員的專業，每年進入柬埔寨: Medical outreach: medical professionals visit Cambodia each year, serving physical needs as a way to minister to spiritual needs.
拉法學院：在柬埔寨籌建拉法護理學院，計劃培養當地基督徒護理人員，將福音深植柬國人: Rapha Institute: developing a nursing institute in Cambodia to train local Christian nursing professionals and help the gospel take root among the people of Cambodia.
漢語教學：差派宣教士進入宣教工場，以漢語教學教師身分在大學或中學當中，一邊教學，: Chinese-language teaching: sending missionaries to teach Chinese at universities or secondary schools while sharing the gospel, leading people to Christ, and training disciples of Jesus Christ.

•加拿大國際關懷協會（CMI Canada）成立於2012年11月，於2015年: • CMI Canada was founded in November 2012 and formally registered as a charity in January 2015. Its first General Secretary was 李愛珍, and Pastor 曾炳海 chaired the board. In November 2014, CMI Canada sent its first missionary, 盛行楚, to Cambodia.
•2022年李愛珍姐妹辭去總幹事一職，奔赴柬埔寨工場，全力配合自己的夫君盛行楚宣: • In 2022, 李愛珍 stepped down as General Secretary and moved to Cambodia to support her husband, missionary and field director 盛行楚. Pastor 曾炳海 succeeded her as General Secretary, and Pastor 龔明鵬 became board chair.

CMI Canada also actively participates in joint prayer across churches and organizations.
